provenance.procedure: GET /search/movie?query=A+Weak+Match&page=1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb search-movie-weak.
provenance.note: Synthesised: /search/movie answers SOMETHING for almost any string. The single hit shares no words with the query, so the client must refuse it (found=false) rather than attach a stranger's poster to the held film — the case the overlap floor exists for.
